name: a thirsty human leaves off wandering, drinks at the fridge, and wanders again

steps.note: the fridge sits in cell (9, 5): x 9*48+24, y 5*48+24, and a map's objects are in pixels
zoomed out so the whole room is on screen at once

steps.shot: an empty kitchen with a fridge in it

steps.note: one human, in the far corner from the fridge; thirst is rolled at spawn

steps.shot: a new human, and what its mind is doing

steps.note: a mouth goes from quenched to parched in five hours of world, so drinking takes
over about three hours after a drink — sooner than eating does, which is what a
person does. 16000 ticks is eight hours of world: enough however it was born

steps.shot: after a drink, and the brains menu saying so

steps.note: the menu follows the simulation, so it is still live as the world runs on
